name: Anecos
source:
While our parents are abroad, I'm house sitting with my easygoing and huge racked older sister. 

After discovering her weak point I'm able to make my fantasy in to reality as I force her to cosplay for me. 

Seeing her dressed up like that... makes me wanna do such bad things to her! 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE040611.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
当我们的父母在国外时，我和我那随和而饱受折磨的姐姐一起坐在家里。

在发现她的弱点后，我强迫她为我进行角色扮演，从而使我的幻想成为现实。

看到她打扮成这样……我真想对她做坏事！

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE040611.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
